name: calendar-of-events
description: Calendar-of-events block. Reads URL params on the page it lives on: no param shows the full upcoming-events list; ?event=<slug> shows that single event's detail (image, title, date/time, description, Buy Tickets); ?date=M/D/YYYY shows events on that date. Feed-driven from the calendar events-index.json; the slug is the event page's last path segment.

sourceContext.originPage: Calendar of Events (list + single-event + by-date views)

config.limit: optional cap on the number of events in the default list (0 = no cap)

visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: dark cards on a light page
